definition: A five-point scale (T1-T5) from CoSAI SRF A.1.3.2 for human intervention severity. T1 = soft guidance (automated, async); T5 = emergency shutdown (CISO/executive, immediate). Higher T is stronger. Canonical copy: /data/oversight-levels.json. Must be declared alongside autonomy level; immediate intervention capability is required at every autonomy level.
